audio.t: Where should we hang our poster for the student research symposium?

questions.explain: 問海報要掛在哪裡，C 指出位置「十二號攤位旁的看板」最合理。A 用 posted 與 poster 音近混淆；B 重複 symposium 但談活動天數，答非所問。

On the board next to booth twelve.

audio.t: Have you registered for the conference in Taichung yet?

questions.explain: 問是否已報名台中的研討會，B 回答「還沒，截止日在下週」直接回應。A 用 register（收銀機）與 registered 混淆；C 重複 conference 但指會議室位置。
options: The cash register is by the door.
Not yet. The deadline is next week.

audio.t: Would you mind giving me some feedback on my abstract?

questions.explain: Would you mind...? 是請求幫忙看摘要，A 欣然答應並請對方寄來最恰當。B 把 abstract 當「抽象的」；C 用 give 與 giving 重複字混淆，且 No 在此語意不通。
options: I'd be happy to. Send it over tonight.
It's a very abstract painting, isn't it?
No, I didn't give it back.

audio.t: Professor Lin, the symposium guidelines say posters should be A zero size. Is that the same size we used last year?
No, last year's posters were smaller. And remember, the campus print shop needs three working days, so send them your file by Wednesday.
Got it. I'll finalize the charts tonight.

audio.t: Did you see the new schedule? Our oral presentation got moved from the morning session to two fifteen.
That's a relief, actually. My lab meeting runs until noon, so I was worried I'd be late.
Great. Let's do a final rehearsal at one o'clock in the seminar room.

options: The rehearsal was moved to the morning.
She doesn't have to present anymore.

audio.t: Attention, symposium participants. The poster session in the Student Activity Center will begin at ten o'clock instead of nine thirty because of a delay in setting up the display boards. Presenters may enter the hall from nine fifteen to hang their posters. Coffee and snacks will be served in the lobby during the wait. Thank you for your patience.

questions.explain: 廣播重點是海報場次因展板布置延誤，從九點半「改到十點開始」。全文未提主講人，也沒有要求重印海報。
options: To report a change in start time
To ask presenters to print new posters

audio.t: Good afternoon, everyone. Since many of you will be presenting at the undergraduate research symposium next Friday, I'd like to share a few tips about poster presentations. First, remember that visitors usually spend less than a minute at each poster, so your title and main finding should be readable from about two meters away. Keep the text short and let your figures tell the story.

Second, prepare a short spoken summary, about thirty seconds long, that explains why your question matters and what you found. Don't just read the poster aloud. The judges care more about how clearly you explain your methods than how many results you have. Third, print a few handouts with a QR code linking to your full report, so interested visitors can read more later.
Finally, the deadline to upload a PDF of your poster to the symposium website is this Wednesday at midnight. If you miss it, your poster won't be considered for the best poster award.

questions.explain: 開頭說 many of you will be presenting at the undergraduate research symposium，聽眾是要發表海報的學生。評審只是被提及的對象。
options: Staff at the campus print shop

options: The student must present orally instead.
The poster will not be eligible for an award.
The student will lose course credit.

questions.explain: 講者建議標題要「兩公尺外看得清楚」，並準備附 QR code 連到完整報告的講義。他說評審不看結果數量、也明確叫大家不要照念海報，筆電則未提及。
options: Make the title readable from a distance
Include as many results as possible
Read the poster text aloud to visitors
Prepare handouts that link to the full report
Bring a laptop to show extra slides

questions.explain: 投稿量大，委員會只「審查」符合格式的摘要，review 最合語意。remind 提醒、reflect 反映、resign 辭職皆不通。

questions.explain: so + 形容詞 + that，修飾「事物」令人印象深刻用 impressive。impressed 用於人「感到」佩服；impression 是名詞、impressively 是副詞。

head: From: Office of Undergraduate Research
To: Symposium Presenters
Subject: Final Reminders for Friday's Symposium
passage: Thank you for being part of this year's Undergraduate Research Symposium on Friday, November 27. Poster setup will take place from 8:30 to 9:15 a.m. in the Student Activity Center. Each presenter will be assigned a numbered board; please check your board number on the symposium website. Pins and tape will be provided, but please do not use glue, as it damages the boards.

Presenters are expected to stand by their posters during their assigned session so that judges and visitors can ask questions. If you are unable to attend, please notify us by Wednesday so that we can reassign your board. Certificates of participation will be issued to all presenters who attend the full session.

Best regards,
Office of Undergraduate Research

questions.explain: 信中寫 please do not use glue, as it damages the boards。圖釘會提供、網站要查、要站在海報旁，都是被要求做的事。
questions.prompt: What are presenters asked NOT to do?

questions.explain: 若無法出席請在週三前 notify us，好讓主辦重新分配看板，意思是「通知」，即 inform。
questions.prompt: The word "notify" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to

passage: Last month, eleven undergraduates from our university presented their work at the Central Taiwan Student Research Conference, the largest event of its kind in the region. For many of them, it was their first time explaining their research to an audience outside their own department.

Lin Yu-ting, a third-year biology major, presented a poster on how water temperature affects the growth of local algae. "I practiced my explanation at least twenty times," she said. "But the real challenge was answering unexpected questions from people in completely different fields. A computer science student asked me how I collected my data, and it made me realize my method section needed to be clearer."

Faculty advisors say this kind of feedback is exactly why conferences matter. "In class, students mostly talk to people who already understand their topic," said Professor Huang Wei-ming, who has supervised student researchers for over a decade. "At a conference, they have to translate their ideas for a general audience. That skill is valuable whether they go on to graduate school or into industry."

Not every presentation went smoothly. Two students reported that their laptops failed to connect to the projector, forcing them to present without slides. "It was stressful," admitted engineering student Kevin Tsai, "but it taught me to know my material well enough that I don't depend on technology."

The Office of Undergraduate Research plans to double its travel grants next year, allowing up to twenty-five students to attend outside conferences. Applications will open in February, and students who have completed at least one semester of supervised research will be eligible.

questions.explain: 全文圍繞十一位大學生到區域研討會發表的經驗與收穫。補助只在最後一段提及且對象是大學生；並非教人設計海報。

Students' experiences presenting at a conference
